_doc: Hidden territory monsters. 4 per continent (one per region, region = index of continents.json regions). Defeating one gives the player a Monster card: the monster joins that player's King when the King enters Last Stand in a Duel. Stats are on the KING scale (a monster equals a King, not a unit: HP 325-490, ATK 26-35, like data/champions.json). Wild monsters take the level of the King that challenges them (side config foe_star = the challenger's commander_star: these base stats x that level's King multipliers; Lv 1 = the plain stats); allies get the King level multipliers (CommanderSystem star HP/ATK mults) of the King level the player had when the card was won (PlayerState.monster_star). buff.type is one of CardDatabase.BUFF_TYPES. Each monster also has an ACTIVE skill (skill_id / active_name / active_value / active_desc, same skill_ids and effects as King skills in data/champions.json): a Monster card ally casts it by hand once (energy cost balance monster_skill_energy, AI sides cast it automatically); a wild monster casts it once by itself when an enemy gets close (balance wild_monster_skill).
